name: TaskFlow Tools
description: Trusted minimal TaskFlow tools for managed flows and approval-gated schedules.

requireCreateApproval.description: Require inline plugin approval before creating a managed TaskFlow. Defaults to true.

requireCancelApproval.description: Require inline plugin approval before requesting TaskFlow cancellation. Defaults to true.

requireScheduleApproval.description: Require inline plugin approval before creating Gateway cron schedules. Defaults to true.

defaultTimezone.description: Timezone used when a recurring schedule omits timezone.

allowedRecipientChannels.description: Optional allowlist for schedule delivery channels.
